title: Mobile 375 viewport preserves quiz CTA reachability
precondition: Quiz entry URL is available in a mobile-width browser
steps: Set viewport to 375x812; progress through age, one single-select page, one multi-select page, and NEXT STEP controls
expected: Primary CTA and answer cards remain visible, tappable, and do not require horizontal scrolling

title: Tablet 768 viewport preserves Paywall plan comparison
precondition: A completed quiz session reaches Paywall
steps: Set viewport to 768x1024 and inspect all plan cards, price copy, renewal copy, FAQ and GET MY PLAN CTA
expected: Plans and compliance text remain readable and no plan card hides the selected state or renewal terms

title: Desktop 1440 viewport keeps checkout surface aligned
precondition: Safe checkout probe mode reaches embedded checkout
steps: Set viewport to 1440x900 and inspect TokenEx card iframe, PayPal entry, order summary and CONTINUE CTA
expected: Payment fields and order summary are aligned, visible, and still protected by the safe no-submit boundary

title: Chrome and Edge produce equivalent funnel states
precondition: Browser automation can run Chromium-compatible browsers
steps: Run the main safe exploration in Chrome or bundled Chromium and in Edge; compare page taxonomy, Paywall plan count and checkout field capture
expected: Core page sequence, plan count, price facts and checkout field set match or documented differences are explained

title: Safari and mobile Safari are included in manual compatibility matrix
precondition: A device/browser matrix is available for manual execution
steps: Execute or schedule the same quiz-to-Paywall smoke path on Safari desktop and mobile Safari
expected: Any Safari-specific viewport, sticky CTA, keyboard or date-picker issue is recorded against the same risk IDs

title: WeChat in-app browser is included in compatibility matrix
precondition: A mobile device with WeChat in-app browser is available
steps: Open the quiz URL in WeChat in-app browser; complete entry, one input page, Paywall view and return from policy link
expected: External links, sticky CTA, input keyboard and payment handoff behavior are documented without submitting payment

title: Keyboard navigation reaches quiz answer cards and primary CTAs
precondition: Desktop browser is focused on Quiz entry
steps: Use Tab and Shift+Tab from entry through representative single-select and multi-select pages
expected: Focus order is logical, visible, and every required control can be reached without a mouse

title: Focus indicator remains visible on Paywall plan selection
precondition: Paywall is visible
steps: Use keyboard navigation across plan cards, policy links, FAQ entries and GET MY PLAN CTA
expected: Visible focus indicator identifies the active plan, links and CTA before activation

title: Form validation errors are announced near invalid inputs
precondition: Email, name or unit input page is visible
steps: Submit empty or invalid values using keyboard only
expected: Error copy appears near the field, is programmatically associated where possible, and does not rely only on color

title: ARIA labels describe checkout iframe fields without exposing card data
precondition: Safe checkout probe mode reaches TokenEx iframe fields
steps: Inspect accessible names for cardholder, card number, expiry, CVV and wallet buttons
expected: Each payment control has a meaningful accessible name while no real card data is entered or logged

title: Color contrast supports Paywall price and renewal disclosure readability
precondition: Paywall is visible in default theme
steps: Check contrast for discounted price, original price, per-day price, renewal copy and money-back policy links
expected: Commercial and compliance copy meets readable contrast expectations or is flagged for design follow-up

title: Loader progress is understandable without relying only on animation
precondition: Loader page is visible
steps: Pause motion if supported or observe progress with reduced-motion setting; inspect percentage text and status copy
expected: Progress state remains understandable through text and does not require animation alone

title: Region and currency remain consistent from Paywall to Checkout
precondition: HKD Paywall path has been captured
steps: Compare Paywall price, per-day price, renewal copy and checkout/order summary currency
expected: Currency symbol, billing interval and total remain consistent across Paywall and Checkout

title: US locale displays expected currency and renewal wording in design matrix
precondition: A US locale or mocked region run is available
steps: Run or design-review the funnel under US locale and compare plan price, tax wording, renewal interval and legal links
expected: USD and regional legal copy are internally consistent; differences from HKD path are documented

title: Date picker respects locale-specific date format
precondition: Event Date page is visible under two locale settings
steps: Select a future date in HK-style and US-style locale contexts; continue and return if possible
expected: Selected date remains unambiguous and is not swapped between month/day positions

title: Translated strings do not overflow mobile controls
precondition: A non-English locale or pseudo-localized copy is available
steps: Set mobile 375 viewport and inspect age options, quiz answer cards, CTA text, Paywall prices and Checkout CTA
expected: Translated or expanded strings wrap cleanly without hiding CTA, price or renewal terms

title: Terms and privacy links route to locale-appropriate documents
precondition: Entry page and Paywall policy links are visible
steps: Open Terms, Privacy and money-back links under two locale or region settings, then return to funnel
expected: Policy pages open in the expected language/region and returning does not lose quiz or Paywall state

title: Quiz first interactive state loads within acceptable threshold
precondition: Fresh session opens entry URL
steps: Measure time from navigation start to visible age options and first clickable CTA under normal network
expected: Entry page becomes interactive within the agreed threshold and slow loads are logged with timestamp and network context

title: Loader has a maximum wait threshold and recovery path
precondition: Loader page is reached after name capture
steps: Measure progress updates; wait until threshold; refresh once if progress stalls
expected: Loader either advances to result/discount/Paywall or presents a recoverable state without losing quiz answers

title: Slow 3G network preserves input and Paywall state
precondition: Browser network throttling is available
steps: Throttle to Slow 3G; complete one input page, loader transition and Paywall view
expected: Inputs are not duplicated or lost, loader copy remains stable, and Paywall pricing appears without partial stale state

title: Quiz answer selection emits one analytics event per committed answer
precondition: Analytics inspection or network capture is enabled in a safe environment
steps: Select a representative single-choice and multi-select answer; inspect event names and payload shape
expected: Exactly one committed-answer event is sent per page with non-sensitive answer/category metadata

title: Paywall impression and plan selection analytics are distinct
precondition: Paywall is visible with three plans
steps: Observe analytics when Paywall loads, when changing selected plan, and when tapping policy links
expected: Paywall impression, plan selection and policy navigation events are distinct and do not include card data

title: Checkout safety probe does not emit purchase success analytics
precondition: Safe checkout probe mode reaches checkout surface
steps: Inspect analytics events while payment fields are observed but no card data is entered and no payment is submitted
expected: No purchase success or subscription activated event is emitted before a real approved payment state

title: Trial-to-active subscription state has clear renewal terms
precondition: Paywall renewal copy is visible before purchase
steps: Design-review post-purchase state transition from trial start to active subscription using Paywall terms
expected: User-facing account state, renewal date and billing interval align with pre-purchase renewal copy

title: Renewal success keeps entitlement active and sends receipt
precondition: Subscription lifecycle design is available
steps: Simulate or design-review renewal success after active subscription period
expected: Entitlement remains active, receipt/notification is sent, and next renewal date is updated

title: Renewal failure enters grace period without immediate data loss
precondition: Subscription lifecycle design is available
steps: Simulate or design-review failed renewal due to payment refusal or gateway timeout
expected: User enters grace period or retry state, receives clear recovery guidance, and plan access rules are explicit

title: User cancellation stops future renewal while preserving current entitlement
precondition: Subscription management entry is available in design or account state
steps: Cancel active subscription before renewal date
expected: Future renewal is stopped, current paid access remains until period end, and confirmation copy is clear

title: Refund state removes or adjusts entitlement consistently
precondition: Refund policy and subscription state design are available
steps: Design-review approved refund after purchase or renewal
expected: Billing, entitlement, email receipt and account copy all reflect refunded state consistently

title: Upgrade and downgrade states recalculate billing and entitlement
precondition: Subscription plan variants are available in design
steps: Upgrade from shorter plan to longer plan, then downgrade for next period in a safe environment or design review
expected: Proration, next billing date and access level are explicit and no duplicate subscription is created

title: Subscription terms remain accessible after checkout
precondition: Post-purchase account or receipt page is available in design
steps: Open subscription terms, refund policy and contact support from account or receipt state
expected: Legal and support links are reachable after purchase and match pre-purchase Paywall terms

title: Checkout abandonment does not create active subscription state
precondition: User reaches checkout surface in safe probe mode
steps: Close checkout, navigate back to Paywall, refresh and reopen session without submitting payment
expected: No active, trial, renewal or purchase-success state is created before approved payment
